summary: Claude Stop/SubagentStop capture orchestrator. Reads session marker, slices the transcript incrementally by stored lineCount, filters evidence through .coldstartignore, steps the trigger state machine; most stops silently tick. Two resume/compaction hazards handled: (1) /compact shrinkage — if stored lineCount exceeds current lines, reset to 0 and reprocess from the new start (else post-compact turns silently drop evidence); (2) resume-blob (#85) — a FRESH marker (OS clears the tmp marker across days) meeting an already-large transcript would reprocess all prior history as this-turn work and cap-fire a diluted blob, so when the marker is fresh AND the transcript is >400 lines it just baselines lineCount and exits silent. Also fixed an off-by-one (#85): text.split('\n') on a newline-terminated transcript yields a phantom trailing '' that inflated lineCount by one and dropped the first line of every next slice. SubagentStop path: recursively resolves the subagent's own transcript (flat subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl or nested subagents/workflows/wf_*/agent-<id>.jsonl), one-shot blocking offer with restate-deliverable tail; compaction agents (acompact*) are skipped silently.

CHANGED 2026-07-24: --manual is no longer read-only on the marker. It now re-reads the marker and sets captured=true on the files it LISTED, because writing nothing meant the next automatic fire re-asked for the exact worklist the user had just written up. It still leaves armed/activeStops/stopsSinceFire/quietRun untouched — that, not byte-equality of the marker, is the real 'cannot perturb automatic firing' guarantee. The re-read before writing is deliberate: a Stop hook may have rewritten the marker since it was loaded, and its counters must not be clobbered.

summary: Claude Stop/SubagentStop capture orchestrator: reads the session marker, slices the transcript by stored lineCount, filters evidence through .coldstartignore, and steps the trigger state machine; most stops tick silently. Resume hazards handled: /compact shrinkage (stored lineCount > current lines -> reset) and a fresh marker meeting an already-large transcript (baseline, fire nothing). CHANGED 2026-07-25: the repo root is no longer taken raw from the Stop payload's cwd. cwd tracks the session shell, which a `cd` in a Bash call can move clean OUT of the repo; root was then wrong and normRel stripped the wrong prefix, admitting foreign absolute paths (e.g. MEMORY.md, drive.mjs under ~/.claude) into the worklist as if repo-local. Fix: findRepoRoot walks up from cwd to the nearest `.coldstart/notebook` ancestor (bare `.coldstart` would falsely match the GLOBAL ~/.coldstart, which has no notebook), and root is FROZEN in the marker (state.root) so every later stop reuses it instead of re-reading the drifted cwd. The --manual branch runs BEFORE the stdin read, self-discovers its session, and (2026-07-24) marks LISTED files captured while leaving armed/activeStops/stopsSinceFire/quietRun untouched.
